# fmc_device_certificate (Data Source)

This data source reads the Device Certificate.

The following restrictions apply:
  - Minimum FMC version: `7.4`

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fmc_device_certificate" "example" {
  id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `certificate_enrollment_id` (String) Id of the certificate enrollment object to enroll on the device.
- `device_id` (String) Id of the device the certificate is enrolled on.
- `domain` (String) Name of the FMC domain
- `id` (String) Id of the object

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Name of the device certificate (derived from the certificate enrollment).
- `type` (String) Type of the object; this value is always 'DeviceCertificate'.
